gloss: to set up; to start; to challenge

forms.label: ている past polite
forms.negative: {仕掛|しか}けていませんでした

definitions.gloss: to set up; to lay (a trap)
definitions.explanation: To prepare a device, trap, or mechanism.

definitions.gloss: to start; to begin (something against someone)
definitions.explanation: To initiate an attack, challenge, or aggressive action.

definitions.gloss: to be in the middle of
definitions.explanation: Combined with other verbs to indicate an action has started but is incomplete.

examples.english: I set a trap in the forest.

notes:
{仕掛|しか}ける is a transitive verb (⟦{他動詞|たどうし}→他動詞：10418_tadoushi⟧) meaning to set something in motion or prepare something, often with strategic intent.

ASPECT (ている):
{仕掛|しか}けて⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧ indicates something is set up or an action has been initiated.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- [trap/device]⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{仕掛|しか}ける — to set up [trap/device]
- [person]⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧[action]⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{仕掛|しか}ける — to start [action] against [person]
- ⟦{罠|わな}→罠：13816_wana⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{仕掛|しか}ける (set a trap)
- ⟦{喧嘩|けんか}→喧嘩：02996_kenka⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{仕掛|しか}ける (pick a fight)
- ⟦{攻撃|こうげき}→攻撃：02748_kougeki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{仕掛|しか}ける (launch an attack)
- ⟦{仕掛|しか}け→仕掛け：07916_shikake⟧ (mechanism, gimmick)

COMPOUND FORM:
〜{仕掛|しか}ける/〜⟦{仕掛|しか}け→仕掛け：07916_shikake⟧ means "in the middle of doing" or "half-done":
- ⟦{読|よ}みかけ→読む：00426_yomu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{本|ほん}→本：00111_hon⟧ (book one is in the middle of reading)
- ⟦{食|た}べかけ→食べる：00396_taberu⟧ (half-eaten)
